claim: vitest >=5.0.0 changed the default of `extends`. Projects defined with an inline configuration inherit options from the root-level configuration by default since Vitest 5.0. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.

vitest >=5.0.0 changed the default of `vitest list`. Since Vitest 5, vitest list parses test files statically instead of running them to collect tests; pass --no-static-parse to run the files instead. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
